div.head: ECf retr 12.5
div.ab: Manbote uero Anglorum lege regi et archiepiscopo III marcas de hominibus eorum propriis, sed episcopo eiusdem comitatus et consuli comitatus et dapifero regis XX solidos; baronibus (autem) aliis X solidos.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 638 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page; the words in bold are the Retractator’s changes to ECf, as Liebermann prints them.

div.ab: But manbot by the law of the English: to the king and the archbishop three marks for their own men, but to the bishop of the same shire and to the consul (earl) of the shire and to the king's steward twenty shillings; to the other barons (however) ten shillings.
